title: Otto
summary: Otto is a desert guide who lives in Mek'ele in Ethiopia. He is a good friend of Zhalia Moon, having worked as a guide for her while she was a member of the Organization.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Otta served as a guide for Zhalia during her missions for [[the Organization]] and the pair became good friends. {{Source|The Golden Asp}}

Otto later served as a guide to the Huntik team on their quest for the Legendary Titan of Spirit, [[Tao]]. After being separated in the Ethiopian desert during a battle with some Suits, he and Zhalia were captured by [[Rassimov]]. After falling victim to [[the Professor]] and his mind-controlling ring of [[Araknos]], Otto became a loyal undercover agent for the Organization. {{source|The Golden Asp}} {{source|To Be Together}}

full_text:
Otto is a desert guide who lives in Mek'ele in Ethiopia. He is a good friend of Zhalia Moon, having worked as a guide for her while she was a member of the Organization.

== History ==
Otta served as a guide for Zhalia during her missions for the Organization and the pair became good friends. [The Golden Asp]

Otto later served as a guide to the Huntik team on their quest for the Legendary Titan of Spirit, Tao. After being separated in the Ethiopian desert during a battle with some Suits, he and Zhalia were captured by Rassimov. After falling victim to the Professor and his mind-controlling ring of Araknos, Otto became a loyal undercover agent for the Organization. [The Golden Asp] [To Be Together]

== Personality ==
Otto is friendly and kind, letting the Huntik team stay in his house and showing off his fantastic cooking. He is also dependable in a crisis, helping the Huntik team escape in his brother's car. He showed bravery in trying to help Zhalia escape the Suits in the desert but also slipped up whilst trying to lie to the Professor that they did not know Dante Vale. [The Golden Asp]
